subject: Invoice intake for indirect suppliers: portal vs email and CSV examples
messages:
From: Hannah Li <h.li@novumservices.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 27 Jun 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Invoice submission for Novum contractors — portal or email?

Hi Marcus,

Quick question on behalf of our finance team — we run a set of subcontractors for the work Redwood engages us for, and our usual flow is to send a consolidated monthly invoice that contains line items from multiple subcontractors. Some smaller subs do not have POs on Redwood's side.

Two asks:
1) Is it required that we use the Redwood vendor portal for invoice ingestion, or can we continue to email invoices to accounts@redwood.com?
2) If email is acceptable, can you share the CSV/line-item format you prefer? We attach a small sample of what we currently send.

A couple of constraints on our end: we often combine 5–12 subcontractor lines per invoice, each with its own remit and tax info; some subs are paid under a parent contractor EIN.

Attached: sample_invoice.csv (small redacted sample).

Thanks,
Hannah Li
Finance Manager, Novum Services
Attachment: sample_invoice.csv (CSV, 2 KB)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Li <h.li@novumservices.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 27 Jun 2026 11:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice submission for Novum contractors — portal or email?

Hi Hannah — thanks for the note and the sample. Short answer: portal is our preferred ingestion path for tracking and automatic PO-matching, but we support a controlled email fallback for indirect/contractor invoices during onboarding and pilots.

What I recommend today:
- Portal first: if you can onboard Novum to the portal, that will give immediate PO linking, idempotency, and automatic remit handling.
- Email fallback: send to accounts@redwood.com with subject token: INVOICE:NOVUM:{vendor-id} (e.g. INVOICE:NOVUM:NV1234). This helps our parser avoid manual triage.

CSV guidance (if you must email): include these columns (CSV header order is flexible but headers required):
- invoice_number, invoice_date (YYYY-MM-DD), total_amount, po_number (or NO_PO), line_description, line_amount, subcontractor_entity, subcontractor_taxid, remit_address, remit_email

Example rows (your sample improved):
\"INV-2026-007\",2026-05-31,4500,PO-8891,\"Engineering hours (subcontractor A)\",1500,\"Subcontractor A\",\"12-3456789\",\"acct-pay@suba.com\",\"payments@suba.com\"
\"INV-2026-007\",2026-05-31,3000,NO_PO,\"Hardware pass-through (Sub B)\",3000,\"Subcontractor B\",\"98-7654321\",\"remit@subb.com\",\"remit@subb.com\"

Operational notes:
- If there is no PO, include a short reason in the CSV (e.g., NO_PO:small-quote, NO_PO:expense-reimbursement).
- Large aggregated invoices (>$5k) will be flagged for manual routing to Purchasing unless a PO is supplied.
- Attach a completed vendor_onboarding_form.pdf for parent contractor data when you first send the email.

I’ve copied Jordan to loop in procurement for exceptions. I will also send an internal note proposing a pilot for indirect suppliers so we have a consistent rule set.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Senior Sales Ops, Redwood Inference
Attachment: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (PDF, 120 KB)

Subject: Fwd: Invoice submission for Novum contractors — portal or email? (pilot proposal)

Team — forwarding Novum's note. They’re an indirect supplier with consolidated monthly invoices that include multiple subcontractor lines and occasional NO_PO items. I propose a short pilot with the following heuristics:
- Stage 1 (30 days): Allow email ingestion using the INVOICE:NOVUM:{vendor-id} subject token and the CSV schema I outlined to Hannah. Require vendor_onboarding_form.pdf and remit info.
- Stage 2 (90 days): Move to portal-only for recurring flows; keep email for one-off exceptions.
- Exception rule: aggregated invoices > $5,000 require a PO or explicit Purchasing approval recorded in HubSpot (REQ-4219).

Please review and comment — Monica, can you confirm the mapping needs for our ledger and whether the subcontractor_entity column is sufficient to preserve AP-level distributables? Vanessa — do we have the tolerance to accept NO_PO up to $5k for this class of vendors with manager approval? I attach the MRA draft SLA for indirect suppliers and a short pilot rollout note.

Thanks,
Marcus

Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Invoice submission for Novum contractors — portal or email? (pilot proposal)

Marcus — thanks for the clear proposal. A few points from ledger/AP perspective: 
- subcontractor_entity column is good and necessary; we also need subcontractor_taxid and remit_address as separate fields to ensure 1099/withholding and remit routing are correct.
- On PO policy: for indirect suppliers (contractors) we can allow NO_PO for up to $5k with manager approval documented in HubSpot. Anything >$5k should route to Purchasing for PO creation unless pre-approved in the SOW.
- For consolidated invoices: we can accept multi-line invoices as long as each line includes the subcontractor_entity and line_amount; AP must be able to split payments by subcontractor remit if requested.
- Onboarding: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf must be completed for the parent contractor and any remits > $1k.

I recommend we add a portal metadata flag \"indirect_supplier:true\" so that when vendors are onboarded via portal the system enforces the subcontractor fields. If portal flags are out of scope this quarter, we should add a validation script in the email parser to require the new headers.

Will draft the expected field mapping and send for review.

- Monica
AP Manager

Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice submission for Novum contractors — portal or email? (pilot proposal)

Thanks for pulling this together, Marcus. I approve the pilot with the following conditions:
- Pilot window: 60 days for Novum (not 30) so we can capture month-end behavior twice.
- NO_PO tolerance: up to $5k with manager sign-off and HubSpot ticket (REQ-4219) logged.
- Any invoice > $25k must have a Purchasing-signed PO regardless of supplier class.
- Require vendor_onboarding_form.pdf and remit data up front; AP will not process invoices missing those fields.
- We will provision a temporary \"indirect-supplier\" label in the portal and add an email-parser rule to require subcontractor_taxid.

Marcus — please run the pilot start checklist and notify Novum of the subject-token convention and CSV headers. Monica — once you have the mapping doc, publish the schema to the onboarding Drive folder and link it in HubSpot.

Hannah — welcome — we’ll treat this as a pilot to be formalized into an onboarding SOP if it works. Expect a short follow-up from Procurement with a pilot kickoff calendar invite and a link to the onboarding form.

Best regards,
Vanessa Ortiz
VP, Finance & Ops
Redwood Inference
